verdict.rationale: Logseq presents itself as a privacy-first, open-source knowledge base. Community users confirm it works with local data and no mandatory subscription, and is offline-first. Several users sync their graphs without the vendor cloud by using GitHub, while Logseq's own Sync is an optional vendor service. Missing for 10: first-party docs explicitly describing local-only storage and operation, a supported self-hostable sync backend (git sync is a user workaround, and one user notes self-hosting is an open feature request), and clarity on whether the new DB version keeps this local-first model.
